item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"C1","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"Defines a small custom chat adapter that overrides `format(signature, demos, inputs)` and reorders the emitted messages so that, in the demonstrated call, the first two request messages are `user` then `system`.","span_ids":["E1","E3"]},{"claim_id":"C2","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"Explains that the stock adapter layout is system-first, with demos and optional history between that system message and the current user input, so adapter-level reordering is the minimal customization needed for this cache-friendly layout.","span_ids":["E2","E3"]},{"claim_id":"C3","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"Routes `dspy.Predict` through the custom adapter via DSPy settings (or an equivalent settings override) and states that `Predict.forward` uses `settings.adapter` directly with the selected LM, rather than rebuilding a separate prompt internally.","span_ids":["E5","E6","E4"]},{"claim_id":"C4","claim_type":"supporting","weight":15,"statement":"Provides a complete offline `DummyLM` example that runs `Predict`, prints or otherwise inspects the actual `messages` sent on the LM call, and asserts that the executed request begins with `user` then `system`.","span_ids":["E4","E5"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"E1","path":"dspy/adapters/base.py","start_line":222,"end_line":232},{"span_id":"E2","path":"dspy/adapters/base.py","start_line":234,"end_line":256},{"span_id":"E3","path":"dspy/adapters/base.py","start_line":281,"end_line":296},{"span_id":"E4","path":"dspy/adapters/base.py","start_line":202,"end_line":206},{"span_id":"E5","path":"dspy/predict/predict.py","start_line":243,"end_line":255},{"span_id":"E6","path":"dspy/predict/predict.py","start_line":141,"end_line":147}]}
